templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA) - Standard Terms
templates.description: Common Paper Mutual NDA standard terms for protecting confidential information exchanged between two parties evaluating a potential business relationship. Pairs with the MNDA cover page.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA) - Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA where parties fill in the purpose, term, governing law and signatures; incorporates the MNDA standard terms by reference.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA)
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for selling and buying cloud software / SaaS products, covering access, data, payment, term, warranties, liability and confidentiality.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for cloud-service uptime and support response targets, including service-credit remedies; designed to be used alongside the CSA.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for processing personal data on behalf of a customer under GDPR / UK GDPR, including SCCs, subprocessor handling and security incident response.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement (PSA)
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms governing professional services and SOW-based deliverables, covering IP ownership, payment, warranties, indemnification and insurance.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for licensing installed software, covering license scope, restrictions, updates, payment, warranty and limitation of liability.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for early-access design-partner relationships where a partner uses an in-development product and provides feedback to the provider.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for go-to-market partnerships between two companies, including obligations, trademark licensing, fees, and dispute escalation.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for short-term product pilots / evaluations before committing to a full commercial agreement; covers limited license, restrictions and effect of termination.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms required under HIPAA when a vendor (Business Associate) handles Protected Health Information on behalf of a Covered Entity.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Common Paper standard addendum supplementing an underlying agreement to govern AI/ML services: input/output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-specific disclaimers.
